name: Venusaur, Charizard & Blastoise Random Constructed Starter Decks

releases.name: Venusaur, Charizard & Blastoise Random Constructed Starter Decks

description.text: Three random-build starter decks, Venusaur★Grass, Charizard★Fire and Blastoise★Water, released on 19 March 2004, three weeks before Flight of Legends, the first expansion of the Pokémon Card Game series that followed ADV. Each 30-card half deck is built around Venusaur ex, Charizard ex or Blastoise ex: that Pokémon's evolution line is always there, and the rest of the cards are random. Each came with a coin, a sheet of paper damage counters and markers, and a rule book. The decks went out of print early.
